notes.precedence: Guardrails are evaluated in the fixed order kill_switch -> opt_out -> attempt_cap -> contact_limit -> quiet_hours -> spend_cap -> dry_run. evaluate_all() runs ALL seven every time (no short-circuit). The terminal is BLOCKED/<PRIMARY> where PRIMARY is the FIRST blocker in this order; report.blocked_by keeps every blocker.
notes.kill_switch: Global halt. Blocks every rung, retry_silent included.
notes.opt_out: customer_id present in the suppression_list table. Blocks contact rungs (email/sms/whatsapp/agent_call); retry_silent still runs because no message reaches the customer.
notes.attempt_cap: Max lifetime dispatched actions per payment_id. Counts real debits in spend_ledger, any rung.
notes.contact_limit: Max dispatched CONTACT-rung actions per customer_id in the rolling window, counted across channels (not per channel).
notes.quiet_hours: Blocks quiet_hours_blocked_rungs between start and end IST (wraps midnight). email and retry_silent always pass. Asia/Kolkata is a DST-free fixed +05:30 offset, so a fixed-offset tzinfo is exact and needs no tzdata.
notes.spend_cap: Daily INR ceiling on action_cost. Blocks when (sum of real debits for the current IST day + this rung's cost) > cap. Exactly-at-cap is allowed (strict >).
notes.dry_run: Never blocks. Marks the action as not dispatched, so the spend_ledger row is written with amount 0.00 and status 'dry_run'.
